disputes.note: Texas and Seattle executed the Howard Johnson / Casey Candaele trade November 1. Their confirmed October 28 agreement names SFQ and CHC 1991 thirds; the execution note instead names NYN and SFQ thirds. NYN third is already held by NYE in the reconciled baseline. SFQ third is credited to SEA. CHC third remains with TEX and NYN third with NYE pending correction; the disputed execution note is preserved, not certified as a valid NYN transfer.

notes: Chicago’s 1991 fourth belongs to BAL under the October 24 confirmed AAA exchange; NYE’s 1991 fifth belongs to HOU under the October 25 confirmed AAA exchange.
BAL’s 1991 fifth moved to SFQ in the executed November 1 Curt Young trade.
TOR’s 1991 round-2 AAA slots were confirmed to NYE for unused 1990 AAA choices; these are separate from regular-round pick rights.

Executed November 14: Chicago sent Les Lancaster, Juan Agosto and Baltimore’s 1991 first back to Baltimore for Norm Charlton. BAL holds its own first; Chicago retained CHI and KCM firsts at that execution.

Pending agreement: NYE posted its 1991 third to CHI for IR player Danny Cox November 13. Chicago confirmation has not been posted in the reviewed thread and no WIS execution is shown. The NYE third remains credited to NYE pending confirmation.

Executed November 14 at 3 PM: Chicago sent Jay Buhner, R.J. Reynolds and its 1991 second to Detroit for Darryl Strawberry and Detroit’s 1991 first. Chicago currently holds CHI, DET and KCM firsts; Detroit holds the CHI second.
Executed November 15 at 7 PM: Philadelphia sent Andres Thomas, Bert Blyleven and its 1991 third to Kansas City for Garry Templeton. KCM holds the PHI third.

Executed November 16 at 2 AM: Chicago sent Jack Clark, Harold Baines and Mike Scott to New York Eagles for Tim Raines and Bud Black. The execution note reads “+ NYE 4th in 92”; this is a 1992 right, separate from the 1991 board. The earlier Danny Cox / NYE 1991 third proposal remains pending.
